# CHANGELOG for v150 - esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol over Wi-Fi and Ethernet
* Implemented device provisioning using QR code scanning
* Introduced a new API for custom device firmware updates

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed a bug causing occasional Wi-Fi disconnections on ESP32C3 modules
* Resolved an issue with incorrect timestamping in device logs
* Corrected a problem with incomplete data transmission over UART

## 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 potential secret in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* Confirmed 0 critical CVEs affecting the current firmware version
* Started reviewing the code for potential security vulnerabilities

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash memory usage, now at 43.9% capacity
* Identified potential savings of 95 KB in flash memory
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 4 new tests to improve code coverage and ensure reliability
* Began reviewing code for adherence to esp-idf coding standards
* Started using AI-powered tools to detect potential issues and improve code quality

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Successfully built the firmware with no errors
* Passed basic functionality tests for Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and UART
* Confirmed Matter protocol compatibility with other devices

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* The security score is currently 0/10, indicating a need for significant improvement
* The presence of 1 potential secret in the codebase poses a security risk
* Some users may experience occasional disconnections or data transmission issues

## 🔜 Next Release
* Address the identified secret and improve the security score
* Apply AI-recommended patches to improve code quality and performance
* Focus on reducing flash memory usage and improving device boot time
